voice.label: Name
voice.help: The voice's name; also the default file name.

voice.label: Language
voice.help: A name your game resolves to a language; empty is the built-in language.

voice.label: Base note
voice.help: The note of a phoneme with pitch 0 (60 is middle C).

voice.label: Pitch
voice.help: Semitones added to every note; tells characters with one voice apart.

voice.label: Variation
voice.help: Random pitch spread, plus or minus this many semitones.

voice.label: Speed
voice.help: Beats per second; a phoneme of length 1 takes one beat.

voice.label: Note length
voice.help: How much of its slot a note sounds.

voice.label: Breath
voice.help: How long the motif's last note rings on after the voice.

voice.label: Motif volume
voice.help: Loudness of the motif; 0 turns it off.

voice.label: Seed
voice.help: Mixed with the text: change it for a different melody of the same lines.

instrument.label: Wave
instrument.help: The oscillator's waveform; noise ignores the pitch (shape it with the filter).

instrument.label: Pulse width
instrument.help: High part of a square's cycle.

instrument.label: Detune
instrument.help: A second oscillator this many semitones away; 0 is one oscillator.

instrument.label: Unison
instrument.help: Copies of the oscillator for a section or choir; 0 and 1 are one.

instrument.label: Spread
instrument.help: Total detune of the unison copies.

instrument.label: Layers
instrument.help: Semitone offsets played together, like a chord: 0, -12, 7. Empty is one note.

instrument.label: Attack
instrument.help: Time to the peak (at least 2 ms).

instrument.label: Decay
instrument.help: Time from the peak to the sustain level.

instrument.label: Sustain
instrument.help: Level held until the note off; 0 ends the note after the decay.

instrument.label: Release
instrument.help: Fade after the note off (at least 2 ms).

instrument.label: Glide from
instrument.help: The note starts this many semitones away and slides to its pitch.

instrument.label: Glide time
instrument.help: How long the glide takes.

instrument.label: Vibrato rate
instrument.help: Speed of the vibrato; 0 is none.

instrument.label: Vibrato depth
instrument.help: Peak pitch swing of the vibrato.

instrument.label: Vibrato delay
instrument.help: The vibrato starts this long after the note on.

instrument.label: Filter
instrument.help: The filter's type (it is off while the cutoff is 0).

instrument.label: Cutoff
instrument.help: Filter frequency; 0 turns the filter off.

instrument.label: Resonance
instrument.help: Emphasis around the cutoff, 0 to below 1.

instrument.label: Gain
instrument.help: Output level of the instrument.

instrument.label: Reverb
instrument.help: Send into the stream's reverb; 0 is dry.

instrument.label: Sample
instrument.help: A sound file your loader resolves; replaces the oscillator. Not playable in the editor yet.

instrument.label: Root
instrument.help: The note the sample sounds at.

instrument.label: Loop
instrument.help: Repeat the loop frames until the envelope ends.

instrument.label: Loop start
instrument.help: First frame of the loop.

instrument.label: Loop end
instrument.help: End of the loop; 0 is the end of the sample.

percussion.label: Based on
percussion.help: A built-in sound to start from; the fields below replace its values.

rhythm.label: Steps per beat
rhythm.help: 2 eighths, 3 triplets, 4 sixteenths; a bar has 4 beats.

rhythm.label: Swing
rhythm.help: Delays every second step by this share of a step.

rhythm.label: Count-in
rhythm.help: Bars of beat before the voice starts.

rhythm.label: Rest after , ; :
rhythm.help: Where the voice starts again after punctuation without an end rule.

rhythm.label: Rest after . ? !
rhythm.help: Where the voice starts again after a sentence end.
